changelog:
Initial release: Easily track, categorize, and export deductible expenses for tax prep.

- Smart categorization by IRS Schedule C/A categories
- Real-time tax savings estimates per deduction
- Audit risk flagging for high-risk entries
- Command-line logging for expenses, mileage, home office, and more
- Exports tax-ready reports for Schedule C, Schedule A, and CSV
summary: Track deductible expenses year-round with smart categorization, receipt logging, and tax-ready export. Organizes by IRS schedule categories, estimates tax savings per deduction, flags audit risks, and generates Schedule C / Schedule A ready reports. Never scramble at tax time again.
